MOD=65536; MASK=MOD-1; TARGET=903; TARGET_MOD=16384; SIGMA='ututut'; LETTERS=('t','u','p'); S=('t','u','p','p')
# Independent tabulated H scanner: old residue -> (new residue, emitted letter) in t,u,p order.
HTABLE=(((0,'t'),(1,'u'),(3,'p')),((3,'p'),(2,'p'),(2,'p')),
        ((2,'p'),(3,'p'),(1,'u')),((1,'u'),(0,'t'),(0,'t')))

def sha(b): return hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
def norm(x): return json.loads(json.dumps(x))
def canon(x): return json.dumps(x,sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':')).encode()

def T(v): return v^((v<<1)|(v<<2))
def G(g,v): return T(v) if g=='t' else T(v)^1 if g=='u' else T(v)^1^(2 if v%2==0 else 0)
def A(v): return (v>>2)^((v>>1)|v)
def cells(g,v,width=None):

 b=[(v>>i)&1 for i in range(width)]
 out=[x^((b[i-1] if i else 0)|(b[i-2] if i>=2 else 0)) for i,x in enumerate(b)]
 if g in ('u','p'): out[0]^=1
 if g=='p' and b[0]==0: out[1]^=1

def oddP(v): return cells('t',2*v+1)>>1

def root(a): return 3 if a=='p' else 1
def omega(q,g): return int((q%16==0 and g=='t') or (q%16==1 and g=='u'))
def gate(q): return 'u' if q%16==7 else 't' if q%16==11 else None

def evaluate(word):

  v=G(g,vals[-1]); assert v==cells(g,vals[-1]); vals.append(v)

def count48(word):

  trace.append([i,d,LETTERS.index(g),nxt,index]); d=nxt

class ValidationFailure(Exception):

def small_scanner_check():

  for phase in ('p','u'):
   for letters in itertools.product(LETTERS,repeat=n):
    guard(); word=phase+''.join(letters); old=root(phase); new=root(phase); d=old%4
    emittedword=[phase]; trace=[]; actualtotal=predictedtotal=0
    for i,g in enumerate(letters,1):
     nextd,emitted=HTABLE[d][LETTERS.index(g)]
     oldnext=cells(g,old); newnext=cells(emitted,new)
     actual=omega(new%16,emitted); predicted=omega(A(old)%16,S[G(g,old)%4])

     ok=(oldnext==G(g,old) and nextd==oldnext%4 and emitted==S[oldnext%4] and new==A(old)
         and newnext==A(oldnext) and actual==predicted)
     if not ok: raise ValidationFailure({'stage':'small_scanner','n':n,'phase':phase,'word':word,**row})

    assert actualcounts['Wstar']==actualtotal==predictedtotal

     'actual_H_Wstar':actualtotal,'formula_H_Wstar':predictedtotal,'edge_checks':trace}); words+=1

  if q%1024==0: guard()
  expected,Q0=accept_formula(q); x=q; states=[q]; branches=[]; complete=True
  if Q0 is None: complete=False
  else:
   for wanted in Q0+SIGMA:
    actual=gate(x)
    if actual!=wanted: complete=False; break
    middle=oddP(x>>2); nxt=cells(actual,middle)
    if middle!=G('p',x>>2) or nxt!=G(actual,G('p',x>>2)):
     raise ValidationFailure({'stage':'accept_arithmetic','q':q,'step':len(branches),'state':x})
    x=nxt; states.append(x); branches.append(actual); counts['direct_executed_steps']+=1
  counts['residues']+=1; counts['steps_'+str(len(branches))]+=1
  independent_A_low=(cells('t',q,6)>>2)&15
  direct=complete and omega(independent_A_low,Q0)==0
  allchecks.append([q,int(expected),int(direct),len(branches)])
  if bool(expected)!=bool(direct):
   raise ValidationFailure({'stage':'accept_predicate','q':q,'formula':expected,'direct':bool(direct),'Q0':Q0,'states':states,'branches':branches})
  if direct:
   accepted.append({'residue':q,'Q0':Q0,'forced_output_mod16384':states[1]%TARGET_MOD,
     'append_cost':omega(independent_A_low,Q0),'direct_states':states,'observed_branches':''.join(branches),
     'six_block_admission':SIGMA+'u','six_block_admissible':True,
     'whole_seven_prefix_with_unobserved_u':Q0+SIGMA+'u',

  trace.append({'position':i,'old_prefix_hex':hex(old),'old_mod4':d,'input_letter':g,'emitted_letter':s,

from collections import Counter
from pathlib import Path
ROOT=Path('/home/ryan/rule30-lab'); OUT=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
START=time.monotonic(); CPU=time.process_time(); UTC=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()
resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(120,120)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(1024**3,1024**3))
AFFINITY=sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0)); os.sched_setaffinity(0,{AFFINITY[0]})
GIT=subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],cwd=ROOT,text=True).strip()
MOD=65536; MASK=MOD-1; TARGET=903; TARGET_MOD=16384; SIGMA='ututut'; LETTERS=('t','u','p'); S=('t','u','p','p')
# Independent tabulated H scanner: old residue -> (new residue, emitted letter) in t,u,p order.
HTABLE=(((0,'t'),(1,'u'),(3,'p')),((3,'p'),(2,'p'),(2,'p')),
        ((2,'p'),(3,'p'),(1,'u')),((1,'u'),(0,'t'),(0,'t')))
def guard():
 if max(time.monotonic()-START,time.process_time()-CPU)>108: raise TimeoutError('108-second computation soft stop')
def sha(b): return hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
def norm(x): return json.loads(json.dumps(x))
def canon(x): return json.dumps(x,sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':')).encode()
def objsha(x): return sha(canon(norm(x)))
def atomic(path,data):

def T(v): return v^((v<<1)|(v<<2))
def G(g,v): return T(v) if g=='t' else T(v)^1 if g=='u' else T(v)^1^(2 if v%2==0 else 0)
def A(v): return (v>>2)^((v>>1)|v)
def cells(g,v,width=None):
 width=v.bit_length()+2 if width is None else width
 b=[(v>>i)&1 for i in range(width)]
 out=[x^((b[i-1] if i else 0)|(b[i-2] if i>=2 else 0)) for i,x in enumerate(b)]
 if g in ('u','p'): out[0]^=1
 if g=='p' and b[0]==0: out[1]^=1
 return sum(x<<i for i,x in enumerate(out))
def oddP(v): return cells('t',2*v+1)>>1

def root(a): return 3 if a=='p' else 1
def omega(q,g): return int((q%16==0 and g=='t') or (q%16==1 and g=='u'))
def gate(q): return 'u' if q%16==7 else 't' if q%16==11 else None

def evaluate(word):
 vals=[0]
 for g in word:
  v=G(g,vals[-1]); assert v==cells(g,vals[-1]); vals.append(v)
 assert vals[1]==root(word[0]); return vals[-1],vals

def count48(word):

  index=3*d+LETTERS.index(g); counts[index]+=1; nxt=G(g,d)&15
  trace.append([i,d,LETTERS.index(g),nxt,index]); d=nxt
 return {'counts48':counts,'Wstar':counts[0]+counts[4],'terminal_mod16':d,'trace':trace,
         'trace_encoding':['word_position','old_mod16','letter_index_t_u_p','new_mod16','edge_index']}

class ValidationFailure(Exception):

def small_scanner_check():
 rows=[]; words=edges=0
 for n in range(6):
  for phase in ('p','u'):
   for letters in itertools.product(LETTERS,repeat=n):
    guard(); word=phase+''.join(letters); old=root(phase); new=root(phase); d=old%4
    emittedword=[phase]; trace=[]; actualtotal=predictedtotal=0
    for i,g in enumerate(letters,1):
     nextd,emitted=HTABLE[d][LETTERS.index(g)]
     oldnext=cells(g,old); newnext=cells(emitted,new)
     actual=omega(new%16,emitted); predicted=omega(A(old)%16,S[G(g,old)%4])
     row={'nonroot_position':i,'old_prefix':old,'H_prefix':new,'input_letter':g,'table_new_residue':nextd,
       'table_emitted':emitted,'formula_emitted':S[G(g,old)%4],'actual_edge_cost':actual,'formula_edge_cost':predicted}
     ok=(oldnext==G(g,old) and nextd==oldnext%4 and emitted==S[oldnext%4] and new==A(old)
         and newnext==A(oldnext) and actual==predicted)
     if not ok: raise ValidationFailure({'stage':'small_scanner','n':n,'phase':phase,'word':word,**row})
     edges+=1; actualtotal+=actual; predictedtotal+=predicted; trace.append(row)
     old=oldnext; new=newnext; d=nextd; emittedword.append(emitted)
    transformed=''.join(emittedword); actualcounts=count48(transformed)
    assert actualcounts['Wstar']==actualtotal==predictedtotal
    rows.append({'n':n,'phase':phase,'word':word,'endpoint':old,'H_word':transformed,'H_endpoint':new,
     'actual_H_Wstar':actualtotal,'formula_H_Wstar':predictedtotal,'edge_checks':trace}); words+=1
 return {'word_count':words,'edge_checks':edges,'rows':rows}

def accept_formula(q):

def accept_validation():

 for q in range(MOD):
  if q%1024==0: guard()
  expected,Q0=accept_formula(q); x=q; states=[q]; branches=[]; complete=True
  if Q0 is None: complete=False
  else:
   for wanted in Q0+SIGMA:
    actual=gate(x)
    if actual!=wanted: complete=False; break
    middle=oddP(x>>2); nxt=cells(actual,middle)
    if middle!=G('p',x>>2) or nxt!=G(actual,G('p',x>>2)):
     raise ValidationFailure({'stage':'accept_arithmetic','q':q,'step':len(branches),'state':x})
    x=nxt; states.append(x); branches.append(actual); counts['direct_executed_steps']+=1
  counts['residues']+=1; counts['steps_'+str(len(branches))]+=1
  independent_A_low=(cells('t',q,6)>>2)&15
  direct=complete and omega(independent_A_low,Q0)==0
  allchecks.append([q,int(expected),int(direct),len(branches)])
  if bool(expected)!=bool(direct):
   raise ValidationFailure({'stage':'accept_predicate','q':q,'formula':expected,'direct':bool(direct),'Q0':Q0,'states':states,'branches':branches})
  if direct:
   accepted.append({'residue':q,'Q0':Q0,'forced_output_mod16384':states[1]%TARGET_MOD,
     'append_cost':omega(independent_A_low,Q0),'direct_states':states,'observed_branches':''.join(branches),
     'six_block_admission':SIGMA+'u','six_block_admissible':True,
     'whole_seven_prefix_with_unobserved_u':Q0+SIGMA+'u',
     'whole_seven_prefix_admissible':not any(s in Q0+SIGMA+'u' for s in ('uu','ttttt','ututtu'))})
 return {'counts':dict(counts),'all_residue_comparisons':allchecks,'comparison_encoding':['q','formula_accept','direct_accept','executed_steps'],
         'accepted_residues':accepted,'comparison_sha256':objsha(allchecks)}

def bfs(phase,accepts):
 start=time.monotonic(); nodes=[[root(phase),-1,-1,0]]; index={root(phase):0}; head=0; found=0 if root(phase) in accepts else None
 attempted=[]; processed=[]; status='running'; allowed=forbidden=0
 try:
  while head<len(nodes) and found is None:
   if head%128==0: guard()
   i=head; head+=1; q,_,_,dist=nodes[i]; tried=0
   Aq=A(q)&15; assert Aq==(cells('t',q,6)>>2)&15
   for gi,g in enumerate(LETTERS):
    tried|=1<<gi; child=G(g,q)&MASK; assert child==cells(g,q,16)
    emitted=S[child&3]; cost=omega(Aq,emitted)
    if cost:
     forbidden+=1; attempted.append([i,gi,child,cost,-1,0]); continue
    allowed+=1; fresh=child not in index
    if fresh:
     ci=len(nodes); index[child]=ci; nodes.append([child,i,gi,dist+1]); assert len(nodes)<=MOD
    else: ci=index[child]
    attempted.append([i,gi,child,cost,ci,int(fresh)])
    if child in accepts: found=ci; break
   processed.append([i,tried])
  status='target_found' if found is not None else 'exhausted_unreachable'
 except TimeoutError: status='incomplete_time_cap'

  assert len(processed)==len(nodes) and all(tried==7 for _,tried in processed)

  'fully_expanded_count':sum(tried==7 for _,tried in processed),'allowed_edges':allowed,'forbidden_edges':forbidden,
  'all_attempted_edges_cell_checked':len(attempted),'discovered_level_counts':dict(sorted(Counter(v[3] for v in nodes).items())),
  'fully_expanded_level_counts':dict(sorted(Counter(nodes[i][3] for i,m in processed if m==7).items())),

  'nodes':nodes,'node_encoding':['residue','parent_discovery_index','incoming_letter_index','distance'],
  'attempted_edges':attempted,'attempted_edge_encoding':['source_index','letter_index','child_residue','output_edge_cost','child_index_or_minus1','new_discovery'],
  'processed_rows':processed,'processed_encoding':['discovery_index','tried_letter_mask'],

def H_with_trace(word):
 d=root(word[0])%4; old=root(word[0]); new=root(word[0]); emitted=[word[0]]; trace=[]

  nd,s=HTABLE[d][LETTERS.index(g)]; on=G(g,old); nn=G(s,new)

  trace.append({'position':i,'old_prefix_hex':hex(old),'old_mod4':d,'input_letter':g,'emitted_letter':s,
    'new_old_prefix_hex':hex(on),'new_H_prefix_hex':hex(nn),
    'actual_output_edge_cost':omega(new%16,s),'formula_output_edge_cost':omega(A(old)%16,S[on%4])})
  old=on; new=nn; d=nd; emitted.append(s)
